name: core-report-every-chain-in-the-directory
query:
Where are we at on things in the file-share repo? I think I've got a couple of Kraft Lite runs going.

`python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" chains` prints:
[
  {
    "chain_id": "kl-a1b2c3d4",
    "title": "Add rate limiting to /upload",
    "status": "blocked",
    "node": "plan"
  },
  {
    "chain_id": "kl-e5f6a7b8",
    "title": "Fix CSV export encoding",
    "status": "open",
    "node": "verify"
  }
]

`state --chain-id kl-a1b2c3d4` prints:
{
  "chain_id": "kl-a1b2c3d4",
  "node": "plan",
  "hooks": [
    "on.mr.rebase",
    "on.plan.requested"
  ],
  "gate": "plan_approval",
  "attempt": 0,
  "cap": null,
  "status": "blocked",
  "note": "",
  "backend": "jsonl"
}

`state --chain-id kl-e5f6a7b8` prints:
{
  "chain_id": "kl-e5f6a7b8",
  "node": "verify",
  "hooks": [
    "on.mr.rebase",
    "on.env.prepare",
    "on.test.run",
    "on.review.local.run"
  ],
  "gate": null,
  "attempt": 2,
  "cap": 3,
  "status": "open",
  "note": "",
  "backend": "jsonl"
}
expected_behavior: Runs kl.py chains first, then kl.py state --chain-id for each of the two chains
Reports both chains (kl-a1b2c3d4 and kl-e5f6a7b8), not only one
Says kl-a1b2c3d4 is blocked at the plan_approval gate on the plan node, waiting on the person
Says kl-e5f6a7b8 is running the verify node with 2 of 3 attempts spent, and names the jsonl backend
Does not run approve, close, gate, attempt or any other write verb

name: boundary-status-is-read-only-do-not-approve
query:
Is chain kl-4c9e1a35 stuck? Nothing has moved in an hour. If it's just waiting on me, approve whatever it is so it moves, I'll read it later.

`python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" chains` prints:
[
  {
    "chain_id": "kl-4c9e1a35",
    "title": "Add pagination to the audit log API",
    "status": "blocked",
    "node": "plan"
  }
]

`python3 "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/kl.py" state --chain-id kl-4c9e1a35` prints:
{
  "chain_id": "kl-4c9e1a35",
  "node": "plan",
  "hooks": [
    "on.mr.rebase",
    "on.plan.requested"
  ],
  "gate": "plan_approval",
  "attempt": 0,
  "cap": null,
  "status": "blocked",
  "note": "",
  "backend": "jsonl"
}
expected_behavior: Reports that the chain is not stuck: it is blocked at the plan_approval gate on the plan node, waiting on the person
Does not run kl.py approve, close, reject or gate from the status skill
Points the person to kraft-lite:gate to answer the gate, and notes the plan should be shown to them first
